QuestInfo.name: Preparation for Knighthood
QuestInfo.0: Leave the room and talk to Father to start training.
QuestInfo.1: If you're ready to start training, talk to Father.
QuestInfo.2:
Knights must abide by #rthree values#k.

First, always seek the truth.
Second, respect and protect the weak, and do not carelessly point your sword.
Third, and most important, #rprotect those who are most precious to you.#k

With those values in mind, we can now begin the training.
